data.body_html:
Marbella Pride 2048 is set to be the biggest celebration of diversity on the Costa del Sol, and there's no better way to mark the occasion than with a Pride 2048 boat rental Puerto Banús. Whether you're planning a sunset cocktail cruise, a day of swimming in the Mediterranean, or a floating party with your chosen family, our fleet of 17 boats offers something for every group. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance – so you can focus on celebrating.

Why Rent a Boat for Marbella Pride 2048?

Marbella's coastline is tailor-made for a Pride celebration. From the glamour of Puerto Banús to the secluded coves of Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés, the sea offers privacy, freedom, and unforgettable views of La Concha mountain. A boat rental lets you escape the crowds, dance to your own music, and anchor at spots where the water is calm and clear. Plus, the sunset over the Mediterranean is the perfect backdrop for pride flag photos.

Our Fleet for Pride 2048

Choose from intimate speedboats for 5 passengers to luxury yachts for up to 12. Here are the highlights:

What's Included in Your Pride Charter?

Every booking includes a professional skipper, fuel, unlimited water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. Insurance and safety equipment are covered, and Spanish IVA (21%) is included in the price. You just bring your pride flags, sunscreen, and enthusiasm.

Popular Itineraries for Pride 2048

Most charters depart from Puerto Banús. Popular routes include cruising past the Golden Mile, anchoring at Cala del Faro for swimming, or heading towards Estepona for a quieter vibe. For sunset lovers, a 2-hour evening cruise around the Marbella coastline is magical. If you have 4-8 hours, you can explore as far as Sotogrande or Cabopino.

How to Book Your Pride Boat Rental

For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), you can book directly online. For all other boats, simply send us a message on WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and duration. We'll respond with availability and a custom quote. Early booking is recommended – Pride week is our busiest period.

Tips for a Perfect Pride Day at Sea

  • Arrive 15 minutes early at Puerto Banús – we'll send you the exact berth.
  • Bring a Bluetooth speaker if your group wants to DJ – all boats have sound systems.
  • Pack swimwear, towels, and biodegradable sunscreen (to protect the marine life).
  • Consider a 4-hour charter to have time for swimming, lunch, and a sunset toast.
